question: On the already pinned triangle, does a total deterministic B state map that commutes with the anchor swap necessarily relocate occupation at the symmetric odd state? Does that also refute the weaker invariant-observable condition?
authorization: One bounded full-domain design attempt under DCTRL-000023 and the continued original contract goal. No branch adoption or model change.
fixed_inputs: R-570 triangle, O={0}, C={1,2}, oriented face. B first local-cutoff schedule only; all functional/rate/state/time data unchanged. No energy, generator, finite semigroup or limit computation.

definitions.target_map: A proposed total deterministic p:X_fine(Q=2q)->X_coarse(Q=q). Surjectivity or p J_B=id would be further requirements, not used by this necessary-condition test.
definitions.strict_state_condition: p(tau y)=tau p(y) for the full source anchor-swap automorphism tau exchanging core vertices, with the exact oriented edge action.
definitions.weaker_original_alternative: For every invariant coarse f, f composed with p is fine invariant. This is an explicit alternative in the original draft, not permission to quotient counting states or drop a symmetry.
definitions.optional_fidelity_condition: Preserve the outer-anchor displayed radial amplitude at the test state, or at q=1 preserve zero occupation on O. These are candidate desiderata, NOT source axioms or already approved contract requirements.
definitions.general_witness: At coarse charge q>=1 and bound M>=q, fine occupations (2q-2,1,1), all aperture/phase/link indices zero. Coarse radial mesh d>0, fine mesh d/2. Specialize q,m,R0 from the pinned fixture for the executed first pair.
definitions.comparison_norm: Inherited observable supremum norm remains unchanged. Any reported radial-coordinate error is a definition diagnostic, not the generator-defect norm.

planned_checks: Derive the complete anchor-preserving vertex permutation group and verify oriented edge/face transport, not adjacency alone.
Verify the fine witness is a legal full counting tuple and fixed by tau.
Enumerate the issued coarse tuples, select tau-fixed tuples and list their occupation vectors.
Independently solve the necessary equation ell_0+2k=q without importing primary or the enumerator.
Use the formula ell_0=q-2k to derive the half-integer radial mismatch; do not infer a nonvanishing limiting defect.
Exhibit why equality on invariant orbit indicators need not imply strict state equivariance; do not claim the example is an admitted full p.
Detect prohibited label erasure, restricting to the even image, gauge repair of occupations, and claiming an all-map no-go.
verification_scope: Primary full coarse fixture plus source cell-action check; non-importing independent integer-constraint and orbit-indicator control; same-task authorship. Lean not required for unapproved definition audit, NOT_RUN unless an actual pinned kernel run is issued.
future_defect: Retain the original draft's complete signed-root Delta=L_fine I-I L_coarse and sup norm, separate Gibbs-L2/state discrepancies, and finite/eventual/limit falsifiers. No defect is evaluated without an actual p.
acceptance: A necessary-condition design boundary with exact hypotheses or a counterexample to the argument. Not acceptance of a full contract; all remaining goal requirements must be audited separately.
non_claims: No all-map impossibility or B-model rejection
No strict state equivariance inferred from invariant-algebra compatibility
No dynamics convergence, infinite volume, physical Pre-A, QFT, gravity or continuum
